machine_contract_role: Machine-readable mirror of the approved commercial and product truth. It does not override production readback or the canonical corporate strategy.
one_liner: Pulse is the independent market instrument for fractional leadership. It shows whether demand is expanding, which C-suite roles are moving, and how strong the evidence is.
category: Market intelligence and benchmarking for fractional leadership
what_it_is: A free public 0-100 composite of fractional-leadership market health
An instrument recalculated after successful daily ingestion, with a weekly brief and seven-day role windows
A transparent public distribution layer for readers, researchers, developers, and AI agents
A future cross-partner benchmark, conditional on privacy-safe first-party engagement data
what_it_is_not: A publisher or media intelligence product
A job marketplace or lead-generation service
Personal career coaching or individual rate advice
An official, institutional, or government index
A real-time, peer-reviewed, academically validated, or backtested forecast

primary_paying_icp.segment: Specialist fractional-executive marketplace, staffing or placement firm, or multi-company talent collective
firmographics: Approximately 5-50 staff or £1m-£30m annual revenue as a targeting heuristic, not a hard qualification gate
At least 50 fractional or interim leadership engagements per year
Uses an ATS, CRM, marketplace, or structured engagement database
Does not have an independent market-intelligence team
Can contribute privacy-safe anonymised engagement data
primary_paying_icp.pays_for: A private benchmark of the firm's book against a verified, privacy-safe multi-partner cohort
pains: Cannot separate firm-specific pipeline weakness from market movement
Prices rates, retainers, and fees from a small internal sample
Sees role and geography changes after requisitions or placements move
Lacks credible external evidence for client, board, and investor conversations
Allocates executive supply with incomplete market context
required_partner_fields: Expected and actual duration where known

secondary_paying_icp.segment: Private-equity portfolio talent or operating team
secondary_paying_icp.qualification: Recurring interim or fractional leadership demand across at least ten portfolio companies
secondary_paying_icp.status: Later market, only after partner data supports relevant cohorts

excluded_buyers: Generic staffing firm without a meaningful fractional-leadership practice
Journalist or investor seeking a one-off statistic
AI agent or developer seeking generic public data
strategy.commercial_thesis: The public instrument earns trust and distribution. The paid value is a proprietary cross-partner engagement benchmark, not a consumer paywall or a larger quota for the same public score.
strategy.moat_metric: Verified partner-contributed engagements in the trailing 12 months that pass schema, provenance, privacy, and quality checks and belong to a publishable cohort.
strategy.cohort_rule: Every displayed partner cohort must meet the approved minimum record count and contain data from at least three independent organisations. Exact suppression rules require legal and privacy review before ingestion.

positioning.public_promise: Read the fractional leadership market like an instrument.
positioning.partner_promise: Benchmark your book against the market before your pipeline tells you too late.
positioning.problem: The fractional leadership market still runs on anecdotes.
positioning.partner_cta: Apply to become a Benchmark Partner

coverage.geography: Current role-demand collectors are United States scoped. English-language cultural inputs can include United Kingdom material but do not create a UK market benchmark. No APAC claim.
coverage.cadence: DataForSEO Google Jobs tasks are prepared daily at 05:00 UTC. Vercel schedules the main ingest at 06:00 UTC daily and a Monday backstop at 06:00 UTC. Supabase also retains a Monday ingest backstop. The composite is recalculated after each successful ingest; the brief and role windows use a weekly context.
coverage.history: The public API exposes up to 12 months of mixed-frequency observations. Daily score rows accumulate from June 2026; full three-pillar coverage does not exist for the entire period.
coverage.publisher_status: A private composite published by Fractionl, not an official or government index

includes: Public REST API and hosted MCP tools

founding_benchmark_partner.status: application-only validation offer, maximum ten organisations
founding_benchmark_partner.eligibility: Primary-ICP fit plus privacy, schema, and data-sharing review
includes: Private cohort prototype where coverage permits
Pilot fee credited to the first annual plan

benchmark_membership.release_gate: At least ten active partners, 500 verified trailing-12-month engagements, approved suppression rules, and safe cohorts
includes: CSV or API export of proprietary benchmark outputs
benchmark_membership.ui_visibility: Defined as a conditional strategy tier. It is not displayed as a live tier on the current pricing page.

enterprise_portfolio.release_gate: At least 1,500 verified engagements and sufficient independent-partner coverage for requested cohorts

validation.stop_rule: Reposition or stop the paid benchmark if fewer than five of 25 qualified firms pay, or if ten partners cannot collectively produce 500 usable records.

api.commercial_status: The public REST API and MCP tools are free distribution surfaces. Optional API keys support operational rate controls, not a paid generic-data tier.
api.auth: No authentication for public read endpoints. Optional x-api-key support may apply rate controls.
api.current_response_note: meta.nextUpdate is a legacy weekly marker calculated as the next Sunday. Use meta.asOf and production schedule readback for freshness; do not treat nextUpdate as the next daily ingest time.

ask_the_index.rate_limit: 12 requests per network-derived key per hour
ask_the_index.output: Server-sent event stream with FACT, INTERPRETATION, and ACTION lines grounded in the current public FWI payload

live_product.authentication: Optional Supabase email/password and Google OAuth account for role persistence and API-key management. Public market surfaces do not require an account.
live_product.operational_api_keys: Signed-in users may mint up to five active free keys. A free key is metered at 1,000 requests per day. Anonymous public reads remain unmetered.
live_product.content_radar: Live as public REST, RSS, and two MCP tools. It reports relative content-signal movement, not search volume or market demand. It is not a primary navigation surface in the current Pulse instrument.
legacy_dormant: Consumer subscription and Stripe tables and functions remain for compatibility
The client Pro gate never locks a public surface
Consumer checkout is not a current offer or route
Waitlist and historical account rows do not validate a paid product

production_snapshot.instruction: Fetch the public API and source-health state for any current claim. This snapshot records the evidence used for documentation reconciliation and must not be treated as a permanently current reading.

not_live: Automated partner-pilot billing or annual-plan checkout

commercial_operations.pilot_transaction_path: Application, qualification, data and privacy review, approved scope, signed agreement, and manual invoicing

competitive_truth.named_competitor: Go Fractional publishes free role, demand, and compensation benchmarks from its own platform and survey data.
competitive_truth.implication: Do not claim Pulse is first or only. The paid thesis must be a privacy-safe, multi-partner engagement benchmark, not generic public role data.

do_not_say: Do not describe adtech, advertising buyers, publishers, media, journalists, individual executives, or AI agents as the primary paying ICP.
Do not pitch a consumer Pro plan or a generic metered API as the business model.
Do not call conditional benchmark plans live or generally available.
Do not call £1,500, £6,000, or £15,000 pricing validated until customers pay.
Do not claim Pulse is the first, only, official, institutional, or government fractional index.
Do not say no competitor exists. Go Fractional publishes free demand and compensation benchmarks.
Do not claim years of uniform historical data.
Do not claim peer review, academic validation, backtesting, or a predictive-accuracy percentage.
Do not say real-time data or real-time market intelligence. Say recalculated after successful daily ingestion and interpreted through a weekly brief or seven-day role window.
Do not claim coverage beyond the six listed C-suite roles or turn UK cultural material into a UK market benchmark. Current role-demand collectors are US-scoped.
Do not publish a per-role supply score. Current role pages measure demand.
Do not claim the Form D signal predicts demand until that relationship is validated.
Do not use em dashes in user-facing copy.
Do not describe the legacy consumer subscription, Stripe, checkout, or waitlist infrastructure as a current Pulse offer.
Do not claim the Supabase daily ingest or deploy-hook crons are active. The production schedule must be read back before describing it.
